system.description:
Instead of attacking with your off-hand weapon, you may use it defensively for an AC bonus. A shield can be used the same way:

  • Light Weapon (off-hand, defensive): +1 AC, but only for one attack per round (the first, unless otherwise specified) — no bonus vs ranged attacks
  • Light Finesse Weapon (off-hand, defensive): +1 AC for all attacks that round — no bonus vs ranged attacks
  • Shield: +1 to the shield's AC bonus until your next turn, against melee and ranged attacks. Declare it at the start of your turn. It costs your extra attacks that turn; if you have none, your attack has Disadvantage

The Actions tab's Defend buttons apply the bonus.
